display.purpose: Film headlines; locally hosted variable font.

body.purpose: Vietnamese body copy and controls; locally hosted.

motion.name: arrow-ease
motion.purpose: 350ms action icon transition and 900ms workflow entrance.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Primary action background and 2px hover lift.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.purpose: Repeatable 48px rise from opacity 0 at viewport entry; 30px on mobile. IntersectionObserver also observes newly mounted content.

motion.name: film-scrub
motion.purpose: Shared native-scroll clock for video and text; pin distance is 3.2 times section height.

motion.name: film-dissolve
motion.purpose: Cream dissolve with a sine exposure bloom and video scale up to 1.055 where a dissolve element exists.

motion.name: word-scrub
motion.purpose: Bridge words fade from 0.2 to 1 with 0.13 stagger.

motion.name: partner-loop
motion.purpose: Half-width horizontal travel, paused offscreen; food divider after feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable reveals, CSS animation and transitions; show all film panels without pinning. Film pinning also stops at viewport heights at most 540px.

components.name: Editorial primary action
components.description: Pill action with a modest lift and directional arrow.

narrative.overview: Food footage, generous cream space, bold Vietnamese typography, tomato actions and butter emphasis. Large balanced headlines set the pace; workflow rows, a split calculator and asymmetric quotations provide distinct reading rhythms. Motion is bold and smooth while native scrolling remains in control. This describes the implemented landing surface, not a new product strategy.

rules.name: Flat content surfaces
rules.body: Use footage, tonal contrast and rules for hierarchy. Reserve the documented floating shadow for the install invitation.

dos: Do preserve local fonts and OFL licenses.
Do keep native scrolling and visible keyboard focus.
Do use lime emphasis on dark surfaces and green on cream.
donts: Don't flatten the workflow, calculator and quotations into identical cards.
Don't introduce ornamental glass panels or gradients throughout the content.
Don't hide essential content behind animation.
